decisions.reason: Shown on the home page indicates strong public commitment and investment, so escalation of commitment makes dropping unlikely.
Presented on its own page signals substantial public commitment and justifies continuing support despite any early difficulties.
Only mentioned on the website reflects limited public commitment, but it builds on the established offer, so escalation still favors keeping.
Mentioned only and close to the existing offer implies lower sunk costs and public commitment, raising drop risk, but not enough to drop yet.
Mentioned on the website and building on the established offer indicates moderate commitment, so keep but with some drop risk.
Mentioned only and close to the established offer means low public commitment and investment, so higher drop probability but still keep.
